drg.description: Simple Pneumonia and Pleurisy without CC/MCC

timeline.text: Chest x-ray: right lower lobe opacity
Transthoracic echo: LVEF 56%, grade I diastolic dysfunction

notes.text:
HISTORY AND PHYSICAL. Chart, labs and overnight events reviewed. 54-year-old female admitted for community-acquired pneumonia. Admission data:
Day 0: labs bilirubin 0.74, bnp 158, creatinine 0.99, hemoglobin 12.4, platelets 207, sodium 139, wbc 5.2; vitals dbp 71-75, heart_rate 85-91, map 88-90, o2_flow 0, resp_rate 16, sbp 117-123, spo2 96-97, temp 36.9-37.2
Day 0 orders/meds/results: Ceftriaxone 1 g IV; Chest x-ray: right lower lobe opacity; Furosemide 20 mg PO daily (home med); Transthoracic echo: LVEF 56%, grade I diastolic dysfunction
Assessment and plan: Community-acquired pneumonia. Hypertension. CHF.

PROGRESS NOTE, hospital day 1. Patient interviewed and examined; nursing notes reviewed. Data:
Day 1: labs creatinine 0.99, hemoglobin 12.7, platelets 212, sodium 139, wbc 5.5; vitals dbp 70-73, heart_rate 86-90, map 86-89, o2_flow 0, resp_rate 16-17, sbp 118-124, spo2 95-97, temp 36.9-37.2
Day 1 orders/meds/results: Ceftriaxone 1 g IV; Furosemide 20 mg PO daily (home med)
Assessment and plan: Community-acquired pneumonia. Hypertension. CHF. Continue current management.

DISCHARGE SUMMARY. 54-year-old female, length of stay 4 days. Hospital course: treated per the plan above with daily labs and vital signs; stable for discharge. Medications reconciled and return precautions reviewed. Discharge diagnoses: Community-acquired pneumonia. Hypertension. CHF. Follow up with primary care in one week. Chart, labs and overnight events reviewed.
